key_idea: Edge traversal is FIFO (leaving later never arrives earlier), so plain Dijkstra on arrival times works with a time-dependent edge cost.
sketch: For departure time d on edge (l,v,w): if d>=t cost l/w; else if d+l/v<=t cost l/v; else arrive at t + (l - v*(t-d))/w. Run Dijkstra with doubles from node 1 at time 0. O(m log n). Pitfalls: handle the case where the speed change happens mid-edge, t=0, and print enough digits; double precision is ample for 1e-6 relative error.
